- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Mentor of — [Joe Sloane](../character/joe-sloane.md) — since v2  <sub>[v2 XII A Jonah Day P18](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0018)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> Suffering from a toothache and a frustrating day, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) mistakenly orders a pupil to throw a package into the school stove, causing an explosion of firecrackers. Later, when [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) plays a prank on her with a mouse, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) loses her temper and whips him. Though distraught over her loss of self-control, she discovers the next morning that the punishment earned Anthony's respect.
>
> — v2 · XII A Jonah Day
